details:
I suggest a change to how private worlds work and also the addition of a new world category called "Unlisted". Currently, private worlds work as follows, the creator hosts a world, invites people, etc. However, anyone who joins the world can then make their way to the VRChat website, copy the link, and host their own instance of the private world whenever they want. This isnt a big deal in most circumstances, but if you want to test something that isnt out to the public yet, having a test world link leaked to me is the same as having a beta of a game leaked. It ruins the surprise. I purpose private worlds get changed so no one other than the creator of said world can host an instance. Copying the link of private worlds should not allow just anyone to host. Instead, create a new category of worlds called "Unlisted". This category will function similarly to the private worlds in the game right now. These worlds allow the creator to host, then anyone can copy the link and host their own session.

Please let me know what yall think of this proposal. Thank you!
title: Private World Change
